name: casamento-daniela-anderson
description: Documentario cinematografico de casamento: 178 fotos, votos e trilha

scripts.preview: node scripts/montar-timeline.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts WeddingFilm out/previa_30s.mp4 --frames=0-899 --codec=h264 --crf=20
scripts.render: npm run check && node scripts/montar-timeline.mjs --final && remotion render src/index.ts WeddingFilm out/Daniela_e_Anderson_Filme.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --audio-codec=aac
scripts.preview:abertura: node scripts/montar-timeline.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts WeddingFilm out/abertura_12s.mp4 --frames=0-359 --codec=h264 --crf=20
scripts.rascunho:completo: node scripts/montar-timeline.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts WeddingFilm out/RASCUNHO_completo_sem_trilha.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=26 --scale=0.5 --audio-codec=aac
